##### Project general facts

Ora Residences by NSHAMA is a refined collection of contemporary homes that exemplifies modern elegance and architectural excellence. The building is defined by sleek lines, lofty windows and dynamic features, and its impressive facade sets a fresh benchmark for urban refinement. Inside it offers a beautifully judged selection of one, two and three bedroom apartments whose modern designs put serenity and relaxation first, so every arrival truly feels like coming home.

Residents enjoy a diverse selection of wellness, entertainment and leisure amenities tailored to every age and lifestyle, all conveniently within reach. A gorgeous swimming pool and a well-equipped gym look after body and mind, while dedicated kids play areas give the youngest residents a place of their own. A BBQ area rounds out the offering, making it easy to gather friends and family for long, relaxed evenings together.

The apartments are spacious and wonderfully well lit, with warm natural colours and hand-selected materials that come together to create a sanctuary of calm and inner peace. Porcelain floors and built-in wardrobes bring a sense of quiet quality to every room, keeping the spaces both elegant and easy to live in. A fully equipped kitchen completes the picture, combining contemporary design with practical functionality to make each home as efficient as it is sophisticated.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai lies Town Square Dubai, a bustling mega-development teeming with life. Central to its charm is the captivating Town Square Park, a scenic oasis serving as the epicenter for both residents and visitors. With its verdant greenery, jogging trails, and recreational areas, the park offers a tranquil reprieve from the city's hustle, fostering a strong sense of community.

Town Square Dubai is replete with top-notch facilities, ensuring a vibrant and dynamic living experience. From sports courts and fitness centers to swimming pools and a plethora of retail and dining options, residents enjoy a rich array of amenities within arm's reach. Adding to the allure is the Town Square Mall, boasting an assortment of shops and entertainment venues to elevate everyday living.

Strategically positioned, Town Square Dubai offers seamless connectivity to major highways, facilitating effortless travel throughout Dubai. Moreover, its proximity to schools, hospitals, and essential services ensures residents lead well-connected and holistic lifestyles, further enhancing the appeal of this exceptional development.
